profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Software engineer with roughly 8 years of experience developing and supporting enterprise-level applications across backend systems, data platforms, and customer-facing tools. Proven track record of designing and delivering scalable solutions, improving system reliability, and supporting production environments. Recently led the end-to-end development of an internal Customer Support platform, including automated job scheduling, database operations, and performance monitoring. Strong experience in full software development lifecycle, incident resolution, and continuous system improvement.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Led the design and development of a full-scale Customer Support platform, now used daily by the support team as a primary operational tool.
* Architected and implemented a dynamic job scheduling system supporting automated and manual execution of database operations, including logging, retry logic, and execution history.
* Migrated background processing from application-dependent execution to Azure Functions-based scheduling, ensuring reliable, continuous job execution independent of system uptime.
* Designed and implemented relational data models.
* Integrated external systems and APIs, including performance monitoring dashboards and support tooling.
* Developed database operation workflows, including automated health checks and sandbox environment provisioning via PowerShell integration.
* Implemented authentication and user management using Azure identity integration.
* Improved system observability through centralized error tracking and performance monitoring dashboards.
* Actively resolved production issues, enhanced UI/UX, and refactored legacy code to improve maintainability and system stability.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · JavaScript · ASP.NET Core · ASP.NET MVC · Microsoft SQL Server · Microsoft Azure · Azure DevOps Services · REST APIs · Software Architecture

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Contributed to the migration of a legacy portal to a modern React-based application, improving performance and usability.
* Enhanced backend systems using C# and .NET Core, focusing on security, scalability, and maintainability.
* Managed and optimized databases across SQL Server and Oracle environments.
* Supported production systems by resolving defects, improving workflows, and maintaining system continuity.
* Participated in code reviews, deployments, and Agile development processes.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET Core · JavaScript · React.js · SQL · Microsoft SQL Server · Oracle SQL Developer · Azure DevOps Services

company.name: Lake Erie College of Osteopathic Medicine

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed and enhanced enterprise insurance application features within a Guidewire-based platform.
* Worked on backend and business logic using Gosu and Java, improving claims processing workflows.
* Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready enhancements and resolve system issues.
* Supported ongoing system operations through incident resolution and feature improvements.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Gosu · JSON · MySQL · ServiceNow · Agile Methodologies · Guidewire ClaimCenter

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Built and enhanced a client-facing portal using C# and .NET Core.
* Focused on usability improvements and backend integration.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET Core · JavaScript · JSON · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · Microsoft Azure · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Modernized a logistics application by migrating from AngularJS to Angular and JavaScript to TypeScript.
* Implemented backend enhancements in Java, improving data processing and frontend integration.
* Improved data handling and filtering performance for large datasets.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · TypeScript · JavaScript · Java · C# · ASP.NET Core · Spring Boot · Jira · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML
